name: Obstracts
description: Obstracts (dogesec) — turns security blogs into structured STIX 2.1 threat intelligence (IoCs, ATT&CK techniques, threat actors, malware, vulnerabilities). Imports each blog post as an INTELEXCHANGE report with AttackTags / ActorTags / MalwareTags / CveTags derived from its extracted STIX objects (ATT&CK ids cross-linked into the matrix). Offline: a STIX bundle ({objects:[…]}) or a posts JSON export. Live: set OBSTRACTS_API_KEY (API-KEY header; omit for an unauthenticated self-hosted instance) and optionally OBSTRACTS_BASE (default https://api.obstracts.com). API: /api/v1/feeds/ → /posts/ → /objects/ ; also exposes a TAXII 2.1 API. https://github.com/muchdogesec/obstracts

parameters.name: file
parameters.help: Offline Obstracts export: a STIX bundle ({objects:[…]}) or a posts JSON ([{…}] / {posts:[…]}).

parameters.name: base
parameters.help: Obstracts API base (default https://api.obstracts.com; self-hosted default http://127.0.0.1:8001). Live mode needs OBSTRACTS_API_KEY in the worker env unless the instance is unauthenticated.

parameters.name: feed_id
parameters.help: Restrict the pull to a single feed (blog) id. Omit to sweep all feeds.

parameters.name: enrich
parameters.help: Fetch each post's extracted STIX objects to derive ATT&CK/actor/malware/CVE tags (true/false). false = fast metadata-only pull.
